newsitem.title: USA: Norwest to buy Central Bancorp.
newsitem.headline: Norwest to buy Central Bancorp.

text.p: Norwest Corp said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy Central Bancorp Inc, a financial services holding company in Fort Worth, for undisclosed terms. The transaction should be completed in the first quarter of 1997, the company said.
Central Bancorporation owns Central Bank and Trust, which has $1.1 billion in assets.

Norwest provides banking, insurance, mortgage and other financial services. The company said its pending acquisitions include Texas Bancorporation Inc, $600 million in assets of Franklin Federal Bancorp and West Columbia National Bank.
